title: Notice how appetite grows
summary: Craving does not arrive fully grown; the shabad notices its first attachments before they harden into direction. Catch the small want while it is still teachable.
takeaway: Catch the first attachment before it becomes the road.
lifeApplication: When a want appears, name its earliest shape—comfort, attention, relief, approval—before obeying it. A craving named early has less authority over the day.

source.shortMeaning: Craving starts with ordinary attachments and becomes dangerous when no one teaches it another direction.
source.lifeApplication: Trace the want back to its first need before it matures into command.

evidence.coreClaim: Craving starts with ordinary attachments and becomes dangerous when no one teaches it another direction.
evidence.turn: By beginning with milk and parents, the shabad makes appetite visible at its roots rather than only at its worst.
evidence.practicalImplication: When a want appears, name its earliest shape—comfort, attention, relief, approval—before obeying it. A craving named early has less authority over the day.
